script.source: The Logic Daemon 1.0 Subject callback creates a Nuker simulacrum at the owner level clamped to 4–7. Its Deactivate callback destroys the current simulacrum.

script.source: The GOB 169 HOT callback stores 14 health, a 15 s lifetime and a 2.5 s interval. The script rounds heal per tick from the stored total divided by duration.
script.runtime: AbilitySupport snapshots the scaled heal and creates a TimedEffects HOT; the periodic executor applies rounded ticks to the friendly target, clamps to missing HP and stops at expiry.
script.test: HotTicksAtTheScriptIntervalAndDoesNotTickAtExpiry and EmergencyRepairsClampsTheRuntimeTickAndLeavesFullHealthUntouched cover cadence and the cap. In native PR594, the stored total is 16, with five +3 ticks and no immediate or sixth tick. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/594#issuecomment-7055400431

behavior-tests.source: The shipped template specifies 10 IS, a 2 s cast, 13 s own reuse, 4 s family reuse and a 15 s friendly HOT affected by caster healing influence.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler checks the cast and cooldowns. AbilitySupport lands the buff and the TimedEffects lifecycle emits its bounded ticks and removes it.
